race: Formula 1 Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2026

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Welcome to The Race Weekend Podcast, where Baku's tight streets meet a Mercedes title charge and a lot of big bragging rights.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Kimi Antonelli is leading the championship, and his BBC Sport interview says he is still finding his way after that 2024 crash.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That crash stayed in his head for a very long time, but now he has eight wins and dominant recent form, so the confidence is high.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Red Bull's Max Verstappen also passed one hundred amateur karters in fourteen laps in an exhibition race, so he is feeling free.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Meanwhile, Formula One has cut the maximum race distance by fifteen kilometres, which could make Baku even more chaotic and a little more fun.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: And if you want to follow Azerbaijan on the BBC, the street circuit is ready for a proper weekend of drama and a few surprises.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Now, our top three starts with Kimi Antonelli, and the confidence is high because the championship is on the line.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: He is championship leader, eight wins, and Mercedes pace is scary, so the data points to him first, but Baku is never easy.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: But Baku history matters, and his average there is fourth, with no podium yet, so we need to stay a little careful.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: That is the risk, yet the data says his form overrides the small street-circuit sample, and that is a big statement we can build on.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: My second is George Russell, and this is where Baku history really comes alive, with two wins on the board.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: He has two wins, strong Baku history, an average finish of fourth point three, and two Baku podiums over three races.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Wait, fourth point three is actually a good average, and his best finish there is second, so he knows this place.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Exactly, so if Mercedes are quick, he is the one to beat on the back straight, and the streets are his playground.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: My third is Max Verstappen, and this is the man I keep coming back to because the track record is simply elite.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Best Baku record, average finish of second point seven, best finish first, and two podiums over three races.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That is the man, but Red Bull need more than a top five habit, and Baku can punish you in a heartbeat.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Still, recent top five form plus the best track record makes him a podium threat, and the data does not lie.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Deep cut: Arvid Lindblad, and this is the low confidence gamble we love, because consistency can sneak into the points.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Consistent recent top ten finishes say he can sneak into the points when the big names make one mistake, and that is enough to keep us on edge.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That is a proper gamble, but Baku loves a one lap mistake from someone bigger, and that is exactly where the fun starts.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Franco Colapinto is the other street-circuit pick, with recent top tens and Alpine points, so he deserves a shot.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: I like that, because the top ten is tight and every single position is up for grabs, especially with the shorter distance, and that is the fun of it.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Ha, we will see about that, but the streets are ready, and the title fight is right there in the mix, so bring the popcorn.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Full top ten: Kimi Antonelli first, George Russell second, Max Verstappen third, Charles Leclerc fourth, Lando Norris fifth, Lewis Hamilton sixth, Oscar Piastri seventh, Liam Lawson eighth, Arvid Lindblad ninth, Franco Colapinto tenth, and Baku, let it rip.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: That is the man, and that is the race, and I am already counting down to the lights before we head back to the pit wall.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Baku, tight streets, big title stakes, see you at the start, and may the best driver win, and I will be watching every lap.
